concepts.label: Email Alerts (Couchbase Server cluster-wide alerting)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the Couchbase Server mechanism dispatching a fixed catalogue of ~24 named cluster-health alerts by email and/or Web-Console pop-up. Checked against the promoted monitoring:alert (Capella's own triggered-notification concept, object of triggersAlert) before minting: no page states the two are the same mechanism - Capella's monitoring:alert is triggered by monitoring:event with a severity enum, while this page's alerts are a closed, named catalogue configured directly through setting-alert/settings/alerts with no separate 'event' object - so kept apart per the no-silent-merge rule rather than reused. Filed under monitoring: (the subject-area namespace for the mechanism), not a new setting: namespace, per this round's standing instruction.

notable_absence.finding: This page's Available Alerts table is a substantial (~24-row) closed catalogue with a stable REST API Name for every entry (auto_failover_node, disk, memory_threshold, indexer_ram_max_usage, etc.), analogous in shape to the 56-role RBAC catalogue or the 28-privilege Capella catalogue that this project has promoted as schemes elsewhere. It was NOT promoted to individual per-alert concepts in this record because no other page in this batch names an individual alert by its REST name, so recurrence for any one row is 1 and the round's own registry-check discipline counsels against minting a whole scheme on a single page's evidence alone (see index-storage-stack's 'recurrence 0 by the only measure the promotion machinery consults' lesson) - flagged here as a strong future-promotion candidate rather than acted on.
